memories.content: On 2026-06-28 Daniel told Mara he has applied for a transfer to his firm's Toronto office (a Nautilus posting), the first concrete step in their long-standing 'who relocates' question; if approved he would move in the fall.

entities.name: Nautilus
entities.description: Daniel's firm, where he applied for a Toronto transfer

memories.content: Mara cried hearing Daniel had applied for the Toronto transfer, moved that after a year of being the only one bending her life around the distance, he was finally putting skin in the game too.
Mara is deliberately holding back from building the whole future on Daniel's job application, saying she has learned not to over-invest in unguaranteed news.
As of 2026-06-28 Mara's Lagos departure is in eleven days (2026-07-09) and she has not started packing.
If Nautilus approves his transfer, Daniel would move to Toronto in the fall of 2026 (as discussed 2026-06-28).
Mara reflected (2026-06-28) that for a year she had been the only one bending her life around the long-distance relationship, so Daniel applying for the transfer felt like him finally bending too.
